subject: Brightwood: private hosting & concession request — exec approval needed
messages:
From: David Park <d.park@brightwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.io>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightwood.ai>, Legal Ops <legalops@brightwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Brightwood hosting: final SOW + special terms request

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Brightwood is keen to move forward. Our security team reviewed the draft SOW and has three asks that are blockers for procurement:

- On-prem / private deployment in our AWS account (VPC peering) with standard telemetry blocked by default.
- Expanded audit rights: ability to perform an annual 5-day operational audit (onsite or remote) and receive 24 months of raw access logs.
- KMS flexibility: allow our external KMS (CloudHSM) with a key-escrow option for your support team under exception.

Separately, procurement is pushing for a 20% first-year discount and a 60-day pilot price. I attached an updated SOW and their risk questions.

Can we get an executive OK on these concessions? If not, what alternatives would move this forward quickly?

Regards,
David Park
Head of IT, Brightwood AI

Attachments: Brightwood_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf), Brightwood_RiskQuestions.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.io>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.io>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Brightwood hosting: final SOW + special terms request

Team — forwarding Brightwood's asks. Quick summary and my read:

- Private/VPC hosting in customer's account: possible via Private offering but increases operational effort and support SLA risk.
- Expanded audit rights (5-day window + 24 months raw logs): SOC2 + exported aggregated logs are fine; handing over raw logs for 24 months is higher risk.
- External KMS + escrow: we support external KMS in Private, but escrow for our support is nonstandard.
- Commercial: 20% first-year discount + 60-day pilot.

Karthik: can you put numbers on the incremental cost (ops+support) for Private in-customer VPC and the impact of allowing the KMS/escrow pattern? Marissa: what legal carveouts would be required? Lauren/Michael: need exec-level decision on discount and audit concessions.

If we can propose a constrained alternative (timebound audit window, redacted logs, limited key-escrow with strict controls, and a pilot credit rather than straight discount) we might close without a full exec waiver.

Thanks — Hannah
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.io>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.io>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Brightwood hosting: final SOW + special terms request

Quick cost/ops readout:

- Private VPC in-customer (with our dedicated runtime in their account): incremental monthly ops/support burn ~ $28k (onboarding + ongoing runbook ops), plus a one-time $45k onboarding engineering fee.
- KMS external: engineering effort minimal to support CloudHSM, but escrow where our engineers hold wrapped key material requires Legal + Security signoff; estimated one-week SLA hit for key-recovery workflows.
- Audit: granting full raw log exports for 24 months has egress and privacy implications. Suggest offering: 90 days raw logs + 24 months aggregated/summary logs (retention policy documented). Allow a single 3-day remote operational audit per year (remote-first, onsite by exception).
- Commercial trade: to land the deal I can recommend a 15% first-year credit (applied as invoice credit) plus a 30-day pilot at reduced rate. Anything beyond 15% needs CRO/CFO signoff.

If execs want to approve the full 20% + 24-month raw logs + unlimited audit days, we should require a Premium Support add-on and a $60k onboarding fee.

Karthik
Senior Manager, Deal Desk
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.io>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.io>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.io>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Brightwood hosting: final SOW + special terms request

Thanks Karthik — and Hannah, thanks for owning the thread.

Decision (requested escalation to execs):

I will provisionally approve the following conditional concessions to close Brightwood this quarter, subject to Legal redlines and a formal signoff from Michael:

- Private VPC deployment in customer's account with $45k onboarding fee and Premium Support (monthly).
- External KMS allowed, but key-escrow is limited: we will accept a wrapped-key escrow where Redwood holds no plaintext key material; access requires a signed emergency access request and two Redwoods approvers.
- Audit concessions: one remote 3-day operational audit per year; Brightwood gets 12 months of full raw logs export. Beyond that, aggregated logs up to 24 months. Onsite audits only with 30 days' notice and Redwood approvals.
- Commercial: approve a 18% first-year invoice credit (one-time credit) and a 30-day pilot at 50% rate. No permanent list-price discount.

Conditions: Legal to add restrictive language on scope of audit (read-only, no forensic access to internal admin controls), strict egress controls, and indemnity for key-recovery operations. Michael — please confirm from finance side. If Michael objects, escalate to CRO.

Lauren
VP, Sales Operations
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.io>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 15:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Brightwood hosting: final SOW + special terms request

I reviewed the numbers and risk positions — I approve Lauren's conditional concessions with one financial tweak: the onboarding fee becomes $60k (to account for recurring ops runbook build and to offset the 18% credit). The invoice credit will be applied over the first two invoices (9% each) to smooth revenue recognition.

Legal/redlines: Hannah/Marissa, please get Legal to finalize the clause language and confirm the wrapped-key escrow pattern is acceptable to Security. If Legal cannot accept the escrow language, revert to internal KMS or refuse escrow.

Once Legal confirms, notify Brightwood and push signature (DocuSign link).

Michael Grant
